resources.string: Paste a link above, then ask a question. Answers come only from that video\'s transcript.
Add your Gemini API key in Settings to get started.
Stored only on this device, encrypted. Get one at aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
How many transcript passages to send to Gemini for each question.
Where answers and embeddings come from. Each provider needs its own key, and a custom server needs its own address.
The OpenAI-compatible base URL, usually ending in /v1 — for example https://your-server.example/v1
Answers and search use two different models. Most servers host the chat model but not an embedding model, so the vector model can be pointed somewhere else with its own address and its own key.
Stored on this device, encrypted, and never sent anywhere except this address.
Model ids are editable in case Google retires one.
Chat and embedding models are whatever your server serves. They are often different: the chat model has no embedding endpoint, so the embedding model is usually a separate one.
Set the server address in Settings first.
Add a separate embedding key in Settings, or switch embeddings back to the same key as the chat provider.
Choose light, dark, or follow your device setting.
Embedding key saved on this device
API key saved on this device
AskYoutube answers questions about a YouTube video using its transcript. It runs entirely on your phone: your API key never leaves the device, and there is no account and no server.
Add your Gemini API key in Settings first.
